entries.text: "The first person to show symptom and die, Jason Colby is a 31 years old male, in the media, he is reported as not employed but actually worked in the top-secret facility L Research Institute laundry room."

entries.raw: '"According to documents provided by an anonymous researcher at the L labs (refer to page 7), the Labose bacteria cannot be stopped once they become active from dormancy and they degrade all organic matter in organisms."'

entries.text: "It was you, wasn't it? You're the one who inserted that strange command into Pan again. The director is looking for you, and she’s furious. You’d better get over here quickly."

entries.raw: '"Because of that command, Pan malfunctioned again, and Section K was in zero gravity for three hours. During that time, 80% of the organisms in Section K died."'
entries.text: "Because of that command, Pan malfunctioned again, and Section K was in zero gravity for three hours. During that time, 80% of the organisms in Section K died."

entries.raw: "\"Congratulations, you've just secured your place in the textbooks as the person who wiped out an entire clade of symbiotic organisms.\""
entries.text: "Congratulations, you've just secured your place in the textbooks as the person who wiped out an entire clade of symbiotic organisms."

entries.raw: "\"I've told you countless times, Pan's prime directive is species preservation. If you keep trying to make it perform genetic manipulation experiments, it will encounter logical errors.\""

It's been three days since I entered the colony, and I've finally found time to write in my diary. Everyone here is so strict."
entries.text:
"October 5, 2037.
It's been three days since I entered the colony, and I've finally found time to write in my diary. Everyone here is so strict."

entries.raw: '"The first two days were filled with various physical examinations, and yesterday was spent learning how to operate... To maintain the colony, they say every resident must periodically wake up and perform maintenance."'
entries.text: "The first two days were filled with various physical examinations, and yesterday was spent learning how to operate... To maintain the colony, they say every resident must periodically wake up and perform maintenance."

entries.raw: "\"Tomorrow, I'll enter cryosleep and won't wake up until... years later. Waking up in a future hundreds of years from now still doesn't feel real.\""
entries.text: "Tomorrow, I'll enter cryosleep and won't wake up until... years later. Waking up in a future hundreds of years from now still doesn't feel real."

entries.raw: '"Awake periods are unbearably dull. Every morning, I press a few buttons as instructed by the AI, and then I have the rest of the day to kill time."'

entries.raw: '"To all prospective colony residents, here are the migration plans. This information is classified as Level 1 security. Any violation of security regulations may result in the cancellation of your migration."'
entries.text: "To all prospective colony residents, here are the migration plans. This information is classified as Level 1 security. Any violation of security regulations may result in the cancellation of your migration."

entries.raw: '"1. Upon completion of migration, the [REDACTED] connected to the homeland will be destroyed."'
entries.text: "1. Upon completion of migration, the [REDACTED] connected to the homeland will be destroyed."

entries.raw: “Returning to the mainland will no longer be possible, and all future residents are considered to have agreed to this condition.”
entries.text: “Returning to the mainland will no longer be possible, and all future residents are considered to have agreed to this condition.”

entries.raw: “Life withers. Objects decay. Ideals distort. Everything in this world grows old… and eventually dies.”
entries.text: “Life withers. Objects decay. Ideals distort. Everything in this world grows old… and eventually dies.”

entries.raw: “But that thing is different. It may appear completely dormant, but it’s still alive.”
entries.text: “But that thing is different. It may appear completely dormant, but it’s still alive.”

entries.raw: “That’s no mere bacterium. It has a will of its own, and it's been waiting—whether for thousands or tens of thousands of years.”
entries.text: “That’s no mere bacterium. It has a will of its own, and it's been waiting—whether for thousands or tens of thousands of years.”

entries.raw: “And that will… it's clearly targeting us—humanity.”
entries.text: “And that will… it's clearly targeting us—humanity.”

entries.raw: “Now, only three colonies still have working communication systems. The hibernation release system broke a long time ago. The oxygen generator will shut down completely by next week.”
entries.text: “Now, only three colonies still have working communication systems. The hibernation release system broke a long time ago. The oxygen generator will shut down completely by next week.”

entries.raw: “Damn it. When I first arrived at the colony, I thought I’d finally escaped that damn bacterium…”
entries.text: “Damn it. When I first arrived at the colony, I thought I’d finally escaped that damn bacterium…”

entries.raw: “…But it turns out we’d already walked right into its trap.”
